001package pkg_RoomPack;
002
003import java.lang.StringBuilder;
004import java.util.HashMap;
005import java.util.Set;
006import java.util.ArrayList;
007
008import pkg_ItemPack.Item;
009import pkg_ItemPack.ItemList;
010
011import pkg_NpcPack.Npc;
012
013/**
014 * Classe Room - un lieu du jeu d'aventure Zuul.
015 *
016 * @author votre nom
017 */
018public class Room
019{
020    private String                      aDescription;
021    private HashMap<String, Room>       exits;
022    private String                      aImageName;
023    private ItemList                    aItems;
024    private boolean                     aLights;
025    private HashMap<String, Door>       aDoors;
026    private HashMap<String, Npc>        aChars;
027    
028    /**
029     * Create a room
030     * pDescription = text deescribing the room
031     * 
032     * @param pDescription String describing the room
033     * @param pImage String containing path to image
034     */
035    public Room(final String pDescription, final String pImage)
036    {
037        this.aDescription = pDescription;
038        this.exits        = new HashMap<String, Room>();
039        this.aImageName   = pImage;
040        this.aItems       = new ItemList();
041        this.aLights      = true;
042        this.aDoors       = new HashMap<String, Door>();
043        this.aChars       = new HashMap<String, Npc>();
044    }// Room(.)
045    
046    // ***** DESCRIPTION ********
047    
048    public String getDescription()
049    {
050        return this.aDescription;
051    }// getDescription()
052    
053    public String getLongDescription()
054    {
055        StringBuilder vLongDescription = new StringBuilder("You are : ");
056        vLongDescription.append(this.aDescription);
057        vLongDescription.append(".\n" + this.getExitString() );
058        vLongDescription.append(".\n" + "Items : " + this.getItemString() );
059        vLongDescription.append(".\n" + "Npcs : " + this.getNpcString() );
060        return vLongDescription.toString();
061    }// getLongDescription()
062
063    public String getItemsDescription()
064    {
065        if ( this.aItems.empty() ) {
066            return "No item here.";
067        }
068        
069        return this.aItems.getItemsDescription();
070    }
071    
072    // ****** MODIFICATIONS *********
073    
074    /**
075     * @param pNom item name
076     * @param pDescription item description
077     * @param pWeight int representing the item's weight
078     */
079    public void addItem(final String pNom, final String pDescription, final int pWeight, final int pValue)
080    {
081        this.aItems.addItem(new Item(pNom, pDescription, pWeight, pValue));
082    }
083    
084    public void removeItem(final String pNom)
085    {
086        this.aItems.removeItem(pNom);
087    }
088    
089    /**
090     * @param pName Npc name
091     * @param pNpc Character added to Room
092     */
093    public void addNpc(final String pName, final Npc pNpc)
094    {
095        this.aChars.put( pName, pNpc );
096    }
097    
098    public void removeNpc(final String pName)
099    {
100        this.aChars.remove(pName);
101    }
102    
103    /**
104     * Define an exit for the room.
105     * 
106     * @param pDirection direction of the exit
107     * @param pNeighbor Room linked to the exit
108     * @param pDoor adds a locked door if true
109     */ 
110    public void setExit(final String pDirection, final Room pNeighbor, final boolean pDoor)
111    {
112        this.exits.put(pDirection, pNeighbor);
113        if (pDoor) this.aDoors.put( pDirection,new Door() );
114    }// setExit(..)
115    
116    public void lightsOn()
117    {
118        this.aLights = true;
119    }
120    
121    public void lightsOff()
122    {
123        this.aLights = false;
124    }
125    
126    /**
127     * sert a allumer eteindre les lumieres
128     */
129    public boolean switchLights()
130    {
131        if ( this.getLights() ) {
132            this.lightsOff();
133            return false;
134        }
135        else {
136            this.lightsOn();
137            return true;
138        }
139    }
140    
141    // ******** GET *************
142    
143    public Room getExit(final String pDirection)
144    {
145        return this.exits.get(pDirection);
146    }// getExit(.)
147    
148    public String getExitString()
149    {
150        StringBuilder vExits = new StringBuilder("Exits : ");
151        for (String vDir: this.exits.keySet()) {
152            vExits.append(vDir + "  ");
153        }
154        return vExits.toString();
155    }// getExitString(.)
156    
157    public ArrayList<String> getExitSet()
158    {
159        ArrayList<String> vAL = new ArrayList<String>(this.exits.keySet());
160        return vAL;
161    }
162    
163    /**
164     * returns String containing all Npcs in the room
165     */
166    public String getNpcString()
167    {
168        if ( this.aChars.isEmpty() ) {
169            return "No one here.";
170        }
171        StringBuilder vNpcs = new StringBuilder("");
172        for (String vNpc : this.aChars.keySet()) {
173            vNpcs.append(vNpc + "  ");
174        }
175        return vNpcs.toString();
176    }
177    
178    public Item getItem( final String pName )
179    {
180        return this.aItems.getItem( pName );
181    }
182    
183    /**
184     * returns String containing list of Item objects in the current Room
185     * if there is no items : returns "No item here."
186     */
187    public String getItemString()
188    {
189        if ( this.aItems.empty() ) {
190            return "No item here.";
191        }
192        return this.aItems.getItemString();
193    }// getExitString(.)
194    
195    /**
196     * accesseur aImageName
197     */
198    public String getImageName()
199    {
200        return this.aImageName;
201    }
202    
203    public boolean getLights()
204    {
205        return this.aLights;
206    }
207    
208    public boolean directionLocked(final String vDirection)
209    {
210        return this.aDoors.get(vDirection).isLocked();
211    }
212    
213    public boolean hasDoor(final String vDirection)
214    {
215        return !(this.aDoors.get(vDirection) == null );
216    }
217    
218    public Door getDoor(final String vDirection)
219    { 
220        return this.aDoors.get(vDirection);
221    }
222}// Room
